visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a pink button-down shirt and round glasses stands before a giant blurred background of simmering red tomato sauce. She holds a large kitchen knife horizontally at eye level, with yellow flat pasta noodles draped symmetrically over the blade. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) A top-down shot of a white saucepan on a gas stove. Two halves of a white onion and several cubes of pale butter are placed inside. Red canned whole tomatoes are poured from a glass bowl into the pot. (3) A wooden spoon stirs the bright red tomato mixture in the white pot. Steam rises slightly as the sauce bubbles. (4) A hand holds a white ceramic grinder, twisting it to sprinkle coarse black pepper and salt over the simmering red sauce. The wooden spoon continues to mix the thickening ingredients. (5) A wide sheet of pale yellow pasta dough rests on a white marble countertop. A small, digitally shrunken version of the woman in the pink shirt lies horizontally on the dough as if it were a bed. Two hands begin to roll the dough from both ends toward the center. (6) A sharp kitchen knife slices the rolled pasta dough into thick, uniform segments on a wooden cutting board. (7) The sliced pasta segments are lifted on the back of the knife blade, causing the noodles to unravel and hang vertically. A tiny figure of the woman is overlayed at the bottom left, gesturing with her hands. (8) Fresh pasta noodles are dropped into a pot of boiling water. The water bubbles vigorously around the pale yellow strands. (9) A pair of black tongs tosses the cooked pasta into the white pot containing the thick tomato sauce, coating each strand thoroughly. (10) The finished pasta is swirled onto a white plate. A hand grates hard cheese over the top, followed by a spoonful of extra sauce and a fresh green basil leaf for garnish.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly, high-pitched female voice speaks in enthusiastic Mandarin over an upbeat acoustic guitar melody. The BGM features rhythmic guitar strumming with a light percussion beat. (2) A distinct wet, splashing sound occurs as tomatoes hit the pot, followed by the metallic click of a stove dial. (3) The rhythmic sound of a pepper grinder twisting with a series of mechanical ratchets is heard clearly against the BGM. (4) A sharp scraping sound of a knife against a wooden board occurs as the dough is sliced. (5) The bubbling sound of boiling water rises in the mix as the speaker's tone remains cheerful and informative. (6) A percussive clinking sound of tongs against a pot is heard, followed by the soft sound of cheese being grated over the dish.
